stories.headline: Indonesia faces $80 billion stock market rout amid MSCI downgrade warning
stories.summary: Indonesian stocks suffered their steepest decline since the Asian Financial Crisis after MSCI warned of a possible downgrade to frontier status. The rout prompted resignations of top financial regulators and raised concerns about President Prabowo's economic policies.

stories.headline: Prabowo's nephew Thomas Djiwandono appointed Bank Indonesia deputy governor
stories.summary: Parliament approved Thomas Djiwandono, President Prabowo's nephew, as Bank Indonesia deputy governor despite concerns about central bank independence. The appointment contributed to rupiah weakness and investor worries.

stories.summary: Multiple parliamentary factions debated whether Polri should remain directly under the president or be placed under a ministry. PDI-P, Golkar, PKS and PKB expressed support for maintaining the current structure under presidential authority.

stories.headline: Danantara announces stock market investments amid market turmoil
stories.summary: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara instructed asset managers to continue buying local stocks with strong fundamentals and liquidity following the market rout. The fund revealed it has been quietly investing in Indonesian equities.

stories.headline: Danantara takes control of seized lands and mining assets from revoked permits
stories.summary: Sovereign wealth fund Danantara began taking over 1 million hectares of land from 28 companies whose permits were revoked over environmental violations linked to Sumatra floods. The fund also created a new BUMN, Perminas, to manage seized mining assets including the Martabe gold mine.

stories.headline: Golkar appoints Sari Yuliati as deputy house speaker replacing Adies Kadir
stories.summary: Golkar Party appointed Sari Yuliati as Deputy Speaker of Parliament to replace Adies Kadir, who resigned after being nominated as Constitutional Court judge. Party chair Bahlil Lahadalia cited inclusivity and women's empowerment as reasons for the selection.

stories.headline: President Prabowo establishes National Energy Council
stories.summary: President Prabowo Subianto inaugurated the membership of the National Energy Council at the State Palace. The ceremony included swearing-in of the daily chairman and council members, with cabinet ministers, TNI commander, and police chief in attendance.

articles.title: Presiden Prabowo Lantik Keanggotaan Dewan Energi Nasional

stories.headline: Danantara secures $1 billion loan and announces major investment plans
stories.summary: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara obtained a $1 billion three-year loan at higher cost than its previous bond issuances. The fund announced readiness to invest up to $14 billion by 2026 across renewable energy, digital infrastructure, healthcare and food security sectors.

articles.title: Danantara Gets $1 Billion Loan at Double Cost of 'Patriot Bonds'

stories.headline: President Prabowo joins Board of Peace alongside Trump
stories.summary: President Prabowo attended the signing ceremony of the Board of Peace (BoP) charter alongside US President Donald Trump. The Indonesian decision to join was described as geopolitical tactical awareness amid weakening multilateralism rather than submission.

articles.title: Prabowo Among the Tough Guys of the Board of Peace

stories.headline: PDI-P criticizes Jokowi's commitment to PSI party
stories.summary: PDI-P politician Guntur Romli sharply criticized former President Joko Widodo for stating he would work 'to the death' for the Indonesian Solidarity Party (PSI). The criticism highlights tensions between PDI-P and the former president.

articles.title: Politikus PDI-P Kritik Jokowi yang Siap 'Mati-matian' untuk PSI

stories.headline: PDI-P calls for government solidarity amid rupiah weakness
stories.summary: PDI-P highlighted the weakening rupiah against the US dollar and urged government solidarity to address the economic crisis. Secretary General Hasto Kristiyanto emphasized the need for all government elements to work together facing global challenges.

articles.title: Rupiah Melemah terhadap Dollar AS, PDI-P Harap Pemerintah Solid

stories.headline: Pertamina announces fuel price reductions effective February 1
stories.summary: State energy company Pertamina announced price cuts for non-subsidized fuels including Pertamax (RON 92), Pertamax Turbo (RON 98), Pertamax Green (RON 95), Dexlite (CN 51), and Pertamina Dex (CN 53) effective February 1, 2026.

articles.title: Turun! Cek Daftar Harga Baru BBM di Semua SPBU Pertamina

stories.headline: Pertamina announces historic oil shipment from Algeria
stories.summary: State energy company PT Pertamina announced the successful arrival of 1 million barrels of crude oil from Algeria, shipped from Oil and Gas Block 405A operated by Pertamina International. The shipment was connected to Cilacap Refinery Unit IV for real-time monitoring.

articles.title: Historic Milestone: Pertamina Ships 1 Million Barrels of Crude Oil from Algeria to Indonesia

stories.headline: Danantara plans to become shareholder in Indonesia Stock Exchange
stories.summary: Danantara CEO Rosan P Roeslani announced the sovereign wealth fund's intention to become a shareholder in Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) after the demutualization process is completed. OJK welcomed the plan, which aligns with the 2023 Financial Sector Development Law.

articles.title: Danantara Incar Kepemilikan Saham BEI, Berapa Persen?

stories.headline: Cabinet reshuffle speculation emerges after Thomas Djiwandono appointment
stories.summary: Golkar and Democratic parties stated they would leave cabinet reshuffle decisions to President Prabowo following speculation triggered by Thomas Djiwandono's selection as Bank Indonesia deputy governor. Party officials emphasized the president's full authority over cabinet composition.

articles.title: Beredar Reshuffle Kabinet, Golkar-Demokrat Serahkan Keputusan ke Presiden

stories.headline: Danantara announces waste-to-energy tender results for February
stories.summary: Danantara will announce the winner of its Waste-to-Energy (WtE) tender in the first half of 2026. The project aims to address increasing urban waste production through innovative energy conversion solutions, involving cooperation with central and local governments, private sector, and global investors.

articles.title: Pemenang Tender Waste to Energy Danantara Diumumkan Februari, Intip Skemanya

stories.headline: Former TNI commander receives LVRI honor award
stories.summary: Former TNI commander General Andika Perkasa received the LVRI Star Honor award directly from LVRI Chairman General HBL Mantiri at an ceremony in Jakarta. The event also included awards to Kraton Majapahit Jakarta for their participation in LVRI activities.

articles.title: JENDERAL TNI PURN ANDIKA PERKASA PEROLEH ANUGERAH BINTANG LVRI

stories.headline: Gerindra celebrates 18th anniversary with 'Unity, Movement, Impact' theme
stories.summary: Gerindra Party announced its 18th anniversary celebration for February 6, 2026, under the theme 'Kompak, Bergerak, Berdampak' (Unity, Movement, Impact). The theme emphasizes collective spirit and solidarity across all party structures from national to grassroots level.

stories.summary: A fact-checking article addressed viral social media clips of President Prabowo's statements about the need for security guarantees for Israel, clarifying the context of his remarks about balanced and realistic approaches to Middle East peace.
